name: toolbox-core
description: Sovereign Mainframe Toolbox — portable intelligence engines for StickThemAnywhere and allied systems.

tools.name: Intelligence Core — Recursive Decomposer
tools.depthLimiting: maxDepth cap (default 5) — hard stop prevents infinite recursion
tools.costTracking: every node carries estimatedCost; sub-trees exceeding costBudget are DEFERRED
tools.description: Breaks a high-level Objective into a depth-bounded task-tree where every node is a concrete, executable unit of work. Recursive expansion calls a pluggable DecomposeFn (rule or LLM backend). Depth limiting: maxDepth cap (default 5). Cost tracking: costPerDepth map gives each depth tier a base cost; cumulativeCost rolls up through the tree; nodes whose running cost would exceed costBudget are auto-pruned and marked DEFERRED. Capability tagging: every leaf is annotated with capability tags the Arbitration Engine (Pillar 24) needs for tool selection. Two built-in DecomposeFn implementations: createRuleDecomposer() — pure keyword-based splitting on conjunctions/numbered steps + regex capability-tag inference; createLlmDecomposer() — calls GPT-4o-mini for structured JSON sub-task breakdown with graceful rule-based fallback. RecursiveDecomposer.getExecutionQueue() returns leaf nodes in BFS order as the agent execution queue. updateNodeStatus() propagates COMPLETE/FAILED/BLOCKED. formatTaskTree() renders the full tree with cost, tags, and status glyphs.

tools.name: Intelligence Core — Reflection Cron
tools.description: Runs on a configurable schedule (default every 6 hours). Each cycle audits Telemetry and Failure logs across all registered pillars and generates System Improvement Proposals (SIPs). SIP lifecycle: PROPOSED → ACCEPTED → APPLIED | REJECTED. Seven SIP generators per cycle: (1) successRate < mutationThreshold (default 0.75) → PROMPT_MUTATION SIP targeting Pillar 23; (2) DEGRADING trend across consecutive windows → ARBITRATION_REVIEW SIP targeting Pillar 24; (3) criticalCount > 0 in FailureRecorder → FAILURE_PATTERN_ALERT SIP (CRITICAL priority); (4) highLatencyPaths > 0 → LATENCY_OPTIMIZATION SIP; (5) successRate ≥ 0.92 + total ≥ 10 → BANDIT_REBALANCE SIP targeting Pillar 28 (increase exploration); deduplicated by category+targetPillar, highest priority wins. Health summary per pillar: score + IMPROVING/STABLE/DEGRADING trend. start()/stop() for lifecycle management; reflect() for manual trigger. onReport callback receives full ReflectionReport after each cycle.

tools.name: Intelligence Core — Bandit Strategy Manager
tools.description: Multi-armed bandit allocation layer that routes agent calls to either ACTIVE (exploit) or CANDIDATE mutation (explore) prompt arms. Default allocation: 20% explore / 80% exploit. Four strategies: EPSILON_GREEDY — explore with probability ε (default 0.20), exploit best arm otherwise; UCB1 — Upper Confidence Bound with configurable c constant (default √2), rewards under-tested arms; THOMPSON — Beta-distribution Thompson Sampling with Johnk's Gamma method, samples posterior belief over each arm; FIXED_SPLIT — static configurable ratio. Arms are sourced from PromptArchive (Pillar 23): ACTIVE prompts = exploit arms, CANDIDATE prompts = explore arms. syncArms(pillarId) hydrates from archive. select(pillarId) returns BanditDecision with promptId, isExplore flag, strategy used. recordReward(pillarId, promptId, success, confidence) updates arm stats: pulls, successes, failures, avgReward, alphaParam/betaParam for Thompson, UCB score. getReport() returns per-pillar stats including exploreRatio, bestArmId, bestArmReward, and ranked arm list. The Reflection Cron (Pillar 27) may issue BANDIT_REBALANCE SIPs to adjust epsilon or exploreFraction.

tools.name: Intelligence Core — Objective Registry
tools.description: Stores Persistent Goals (Objectives) injected as the primary system prompt context into every spawned agent. Each Objective has: title, natural-language statement, ObjectiveCategory (ACCURACY/REVENUE/VELOCITY/QUALITY/RESILIENCE/GROWTH/SOVEREIGNTY), priority weight [0,1], owner pillar, linked pillars, and an ObjectiveMetric (name, currentValue, targetValue, unit, direction=HIGHER_IS_BETTER|LOWER_IS_BETTER). Auto-generates promptFragment — imperative instruction string with current/target/gap — rebuilt whenever updateMetric() is called. Auto-achieves status when currentValue reaches targetValue. buildSystemPromptBlock(pillarFilter?, maxObjectives?) assembles the SOVEREIGN OBJECTIVES block with ASCII progress bars and priority labels ([CRITICAL PRIORITY]/[HIGH PRIORITY]/[STANDARD]). injectIntoPrompt(systemPrompt) prepends the block to any agent system prompt. Three canonical bootstrap objectives via seedSovereignObjectives(): System Accuracy (avg_critic_confidence 0.70→0.90, ACCURACY, w=0.90), Revenue Generation (conversion_rate 2%→5%, REVENUE, w=0.80), Execution Velocity (avg_task_latency 3200ms→5000ms, VELOCITY, w=0.70). Progress tracking: getProgress() returns progressPct, gap, onTrack flag.

tools.name: Wisdom Vault — Failure Recorder
tools.description: Negative knowledge indexer for the Sovereign Mainframe. Records three failure categories: FAILED_SEQUENCE (toolId chain that ended in FAILED/ABANDON — records breakIndex and breakingToolId), REJECTED_OUTPUT (CRITIC rejection — records outputHash, promptHash, rejectionReason, criticConfidence), HIGH_LATENCY_PATH (observed vs budget latency, latencyOveragePercent). Root cause taxonomy: LINGUISTIC (prompt phrasing → hallucination/incoherence/format violation), LOGIC (agent reasoning → wrong plan/circular dependency), TOOL_MISMATCH (wrong tool selection → StC mismatch/API unavailable). Severity auto-computed from category+rootCause+recurrenceCount: CRITICAL (≥7 points), HIGH (≥5), MEDIUM (≥3), LOW (<3). Upsert logic: identical pattern (taskHash + category + breakingToolId/outputHash) increments recurrenceCount rather than creating a new record. negativeConstraint field: imperative constraint string auto-generated per category — 'Do NOT use sequence [X→Y→Z] — failed at Y', 'Do NOT produce output from prompt starting with [prompt prefix]', 'Do NOT invoke path [X] — exceeded latency budget by N%'. getConstraintsForTask(taskInput, pillarId) merges exact-hash matches + 7-day pillar-scoped matches, sorts by severity→recurrences. pillarSummary() returns totals per category, criticalCount, topRootCause, recurringPatterns count.

tools.name: Wisdom Vault — Pre-Flight Check
tools.description: Pre-execution gate that queries the Negative Knowledge Base and injects failure-derived constraints into an agent's system prompt before any tool is called. Five-step pipeline: (1) hash taskInput via FNV-1a; (2) query FailureRecorder.getConstraintsForTask() — merges exact-hash + 7-day pillar-scoped failures; (3) optionally query SequenceAnalyzer for known-FAILED chains and derive LOGIC constraints; (4) merge, filter by minSeverity (default LOW), sort by severity→recurrences→source (recorder > analyzer), deduplicate by text prefix, slice to maxConstraints (default 10); (5) build NEGATIVE KNOWLEDGE block and prepend to system prompt. Injected block format: '══ NEGATIVE KNOWLEDGE ══ / [SEVERITY / ROOT_CAUSE] constraint text (Nx recurrence) / ═══'. Risk assessment: CLEAR (0 constraints), LOW (≥1), ELEVATED (hasHigh or totalRecurr≥10), HIGH (hasCritical), BLOCKED (hasCritical + totalRecurr≥5). Recommendations: PROCEED / PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION / RE_ARBITRATE / ESCALATE / BLOCK. checkOrThrow() throws if recommendation=BLOCK. checkBatch() runs multiple checks concurrently. PreFlightReport: taskHash, constraintsFound/Injected, riskLevel, recommendation, constraints[], augmentedPrompt (full system prompt + block), negativeKnowledgeBlock (block alone), checkLatencyMs.

tools.name: Tactical Strategy — Weighted Tool Registry
tools.description: Indexed registry for all Sovereign Mainframe tools with a computed Success-to-Cost (StC) ratio. StC = (successRate × avgConfidence) / normalizedCost where normalizedCost = tool.compute / max(compute across registry). Tools with zero invocations receive a neutral prior (sr=0.5, conf=0.5) for bootstrapping. WeightedToolEntry fields: toolId, name, pillarId, description, capabilityTags[], taxonomyDomains[], ToolCost (compute, latencyMs, hasApiCost, tier), ToolPerformance (invocations, successCount, retryCount, abandonCount, avgLatencyMs, avgConfidence, successRate, stcRatio, lastUpdatedAt), status, path, exports[]. Query API: byTags(tags[]) requires ALL tags; bestFor(tags[], n) returns top-N; byPillar(id) returns all tools for a pillar; query(ToolQuery) supports full filter set (tags, anyTags, pillarId, status, tier, maxLatencyMs, hasApiCost, minStcRatio, limit); search(term) fuzzy-matches name + description + tags. buildRegistryFromManifest() bootstraps a registry directly from toolbox-manifest.json — derives 30 capability tags via keyword regex map. recordInvocation() and syncFromTelemetry() update live performance stats and trigger recomputeStC().

tools.name: Tactical Strategy — Sequence Analyzer
tools.patternAlgorithm: Sliding-window contiguous subsequence mining (no external ML)
tools.description: Chain-of-invocation tracker and strategic blueprint extractor. InvocationChain: records all steps (toolId, inputHash, outputHash, latencyMs, outcome, confidence, capabilityTags, calledAt), chainId, agentId, pillarId, goalLabel, totalLatencyMs, avgConfidence, sequenceHash (FNV-1a of toolId sequence), outcome (SUCCESS/PARTIAL/FAILED). ChainBuilder: fluent API — startChain(agentId, pillarId, goalLabel) → .step(toolId, input, output, latencyMs, outcome, confidence, tags) → .build(outcome). SequenceAnalyzer.record(chain) stores the chain and immediately re-mines blueprints. Pattern mining: sliding-window over successful chains, extracts all contiguous subsequences in [minLength, maxLength] (defaults 2–8), promotes to StrategyBlueprint if support ≥ minSupport (default 0.20 = appears in ≥20% of successful chains). StrategyBlueprint: toolSequence[], BlueprintStep[] (per-step avgConfidence/avgLatencyMs/successRate/capabilityTags), frequency, support, avgTotalLatencyMs, avgChainConfidence, predictedSuccessRate, goalLabels[]. Retrieval: getAllBlueprints() sorted by frequency×confidence; getBlueprintsForPillar(id, limit); getBlueprintsForCapabilities(requiredTags[]) filters blueprints whose aggregate step tags cover all required tags; getBlueprintForGoal(goalLabel) substring match. formatBlueprintHint() produces a human-readable HINT string for agent system prompts.

tools.name: Tactical Strategy — Arbitration Engine Agent Instructions
tools.description: Agent instruction document for the Arbitration Engine. Defines a 5-step decision protocol: (1) Check Blueprint — if predictedSuccessRate ≥ 0.75 and all tools ACTIVE → BLUEPRINT_FOLLOW; (2) Query Registry — byTags + constraint filters, sort by StC, select top-ranked per step; (3) Assign Fallbacks — one fallback per step sharing at least one capability tag, prefer no-API-cost; (4) Hybrid Override — blueprint for steps 1-N, registry-optimized for remainder; (5) FALLBACK_ONLY — when registry < 2 matching tools, flag as coverage gap. Output format: ARBITRATION PLAN with Goal, Pillar, Strategy, numbered Steps (toolId/Reason/Expected latency/StC ratio/On failure), Total expected latency, Confidence, and ARBITRATION NOTES (strategy rationale, key risk, coverage gap). Prohibited: DEPRECATED/DISABLED tools, invented IDs, >10 steps without decomposition, direct tool execution. Re-arbitration triggers documented. Full worked example included.

tools.name: Linguistic Forge — Prompt Archive
tools.description: Indexed store for all prompt templates in the Sovereign Mainframe. Each PromptRecord carries: template (raw string with {{variable}} placeholders), pillarId, agentRole, generation (0=seed), parentIds[], mutationType, status (CANDIDATE/ACTIVE/ARCHIVED), PromptFitness (score[0,1], invocations, successCount, retryCount, abandonCount, avgLatencyMs, avgConfidence, lastEvaluatedAt), tags[], lineage. PromptArchive methods: seed() (registers a new gen-0 SEED prompt), register(), get(), find(filter), getBest(pillarId, limit), getActive(), getCandidates(), updateFitness() (integrates scores from FeedbackScorer), activate(), archive(), applyABResult(winnerId, loserId) (promotes winner, archives loser — called by FitnessEvaluator), getLineage() (walks parentIds tree), pillarStats(). Two adapters: InMemoryPromptArchive (Map-based, circular, sorted by score) and createSupabasePromptArchive (persistent REST — requires prompt_archive table with JSONB fitness column and score index).

tools.name: Linguistic Forge — Mutation Engine
tools.description: Evolutionary operators for prompt templates. Two operator families: Perturbation (perturb(parent) → 3 CANDIDATE PromptRecords, one per type) and Crossover (crossover(parentA, parentB, strategy) → 1 child PromptRecord). Perturbation types — TONE: detects current register and flips it (formal↔casual) or applies assertive prefix / curious suffix; rule-based via 20+ regex substitutions or LLM rewrite. STRUCTURE: reverses paragraph blocks, converts bullet↔numbered lists; LLM mode rewrites instruction ordering. CONSTRAINT: adds/removes one output constraint (word limit, format, scope) cycling through 5 presets; LLM mode reasons about appropriate constraint changes. Crossover strategies — INTERLEAVE: alternates paragraph blocks from both parents, deduplicates adjacent identicals; PREFIX: parent A preamble + parent B body; SUFFIX: parent A body + parent B closing. Two backends: createRuleMutator() (fully deterministic, zero API calls, 400 lines of pure string manipulation) and createLlmMutator(opts) (OpenAI-compatible, temperature=0.7, max_tokens=1024). evolveGeneration(prompts[]) runs a full round: select top-2 elite → perturb best → crossover top-2 with all 3 strategies → return 6 new CANDIDATEs.

tools.name: Linguistic Forge — Fitness Evaluator
tools.description: A/B test engine for prompt variants. Three evaluation modes — SIMULATED: runs both arms concurrently against every test input, collects RunResult[], logs to TelemetryLogger. SEQUENTIAL: runs control arm first then challenger arm against same inputs (reduces concurrency bias). SHADOW: control arm serves real requests synchronously; challenger runs fire-and-forget in background (output discarded). Scoring per arm uses same weighted model as FeedbackScorer (successRate×0.50 + inverseAbandon×0.25 + avgConfidence×0.15 + latencyScore×0.10). Winner selection: if |delta| < minDelta (default 0.02) → TIE (control retained); otherwise highest score wins. After test: both prompts' fitness scores updated in PromptArchive; winner set ACTIVE, loser ARCHIVED (archive.applyABResult). ABTestReport includes: testId, mode, both ArmStats (runs/successes/retries/abandons/avgLatencyMs/avgConfidence/score), winner, scoreDelta, applied flag, notes string. Two RunFn factories: createMockRunFn(successRate, avgLatencyMs, jitter) for NAS dry-runs; createLlmRunFn(opts) infers outcome from response length heuristic.

tools.name: Evolution Engine — Telemetry Logger
tools.description: Structured telemetry recording system for every agent invocation. Captures [timestamp, agent_id, pillar_id, input_hash, output_hash, latency_ms, outcome, confidence, retry_count, tags, metadata] per event. Outcome signals: SUCCESS (agent completed, output accepted), RETRY (CRITIC rejected output, agent re-runs), ABANDON (max retries exhausted). Hashing via FNV-1a 32-bit on JSON-serialised payload — not cryptographic, used for deduplication and drift detection. Two storage adapters: InMemoryTelemetryStore (circular buffer, configurable maxSize, drop-oldest) and createSupabaseTelemetryStore (persistent, full CRUD via Supabase REST API — requires agent_telemetry table). TelemetryLogger provides: log(), logSuccess(), logRetry(), logAbandon(), startTimer() (returns stop(output, outcome) closure for automatic latency capture), getHistory(filter), pillarSummary(pillarId). pillarSummary returns: total, successes, retries, abandons, avgLatencyMs, avgConfidence, successRate.

tools.name: Evolution Engine — Feedback Scorer
tools.description: Rolling Confidence Score engine for all Sovereign Mainframe pillars. Consumes TelemetryLogger history; computes a [0,1] score per pillar from four weighted factors: successRate (0.50), inverseAbandon (0.25), avgConfidence (0.15), latencyScore (0.10 — penalises latency above latencyCapMs). Configurable rolling window (default 24h), minimum event threshold before scoring (default 5 — returns neutral 1.0 below threshold). Five grades: OPTIMAL/HEALTHY/WARNING/CRITICAL/FAILING. Automatic Optimization: when score < degradationThreshold (default 0.85), all registered OptimizationHandlers for that pillar fire concurrently. Handlers receive PillarDiagnostic: score breakdown, last 50 telemetry records, dominant failure mode (RETRY/ABANDON/none), weakest agent (most non-SUCCESS events), and a natural-language suggestion. Built-in handlers: createRetryWindowHandler (lowers hallucinationThreshold by configurable step, min 0.50, stored in passed configStore Map), createAlertHandler (structured console warn + optional webhook POST), createCompositeHandler (chains N handlers, catches individual failures). evaluateAll(pillarIds[]) returns ScoreboardReport sorted worst-first. formatScoreboard() renders ASCII scoreboard with score bars, grades, and optimization counts.

tools.name: StickerEngine — Naming Tool
tools.description: Normalizes raw strings into canonical uppercase-hyphen sticker codes. Provides slug generation, display name derivation, and batch normalization.

tools.name: StickerEngine — Taxonomy Tool
tools.description: In-memory taxonomy tree operations. Mirrors Convex taxonomy table logic without DB imports. Supports upsert dedup, ancestor walks, danger-level filtering, and structural validation.

tools.name: Gematria Engine
tools.description: Standard Gematria (Mispar Hechrachi) calculator with optional extended sofit values and theosophical digit reduction.

tools.name: Redesign Analyzer Engine
tools.description: Scores and classifies business websites as PRIMARY_TARGET, MONITOR, or PASS based on visual score, mobile responsiveness, CTA density, load speed, and trust signals.

tools.name: Persistent Agents — Agent Heartbeat
tools.description: Two-class system for always-on agent management. AgentHeartbeat: registers named WORKER/CRITIC/FIXER/MONITOR/CUSTOM agents, each with a TickFn async loop running at configurable intervalMs. Exponential back-off on failure (backOffBaseMs × 2^consecutiveErrors, capped at backOffMaxMs). FAULTED state after maxConsecutiveErrors. Graceful shutdown via AbortController (SIGTERM/SIGINT via registerShutdownHandlers). Per-agent AgentHealth ledger: status, tickCount, errorCount, consecutiveErrors, lastTickAt, recentErrors[5]. pause()/resume() lifecycle. GoalMonitor: polls a MetricFetcher (DB query, API, in-memory) at configurable cadence, fires a GoalTask when threshold condition is met — RISING/FALLING (edge-triggered) or BAND_EXIT/BAND_ENTER (range-triggered). ONE_SHOT (auto-stops after first fire) or REPEATING. formatHeartbeatDashboard() renders ASCII status table for both systems.

tools.name: Ambient Intelligence — Ambient Stream Ingestor
tools.description: Real-time sensor telemetry ingestion and routing system. Accepts five sensor types: WIFI_CSI (amplitude/phase matrices → variance-based motion detection), CAMERA (base64 JPEG/PNG → routed to visual-analyzer semantic tagger), IOT (key/value readings → threshold breach detection), AUDIO (amplitude/frequency vectors), CUSTOM (arbitrary payloads). SensorFrame → FrameHandler chain: handlers declare accepted types, sorted by priority, run concurrently per frame. ClassificationResult per handler: label (PRESENCE_DETECTED/MOTION_DETECTED/TAGGED/THRESHOLD_CROSSED/ANOMALY_DETECTED/ROUTED/SKIPPED), confidence, tags[], metadata. Ring buffer per sensor type caps memory (default 500 frames, drop-oldest). SensorAdapter interface: connect() returns cleanup fn — inject WebSocket, HTTP POST, MQTT, serial. createHttpPostAdapter() global symbol bridge; createSimulatedAdapter() for testing. onAnomaly + onFrameProcessed callbacks for GoalMonitor integration. flushReport() for windowed telemetry summaries.

tools.name: Semantic Tagging Layer — Visual Analyzer
tools.description: VLM-powered image asset analyser. Extracts three primary dimensions per asset: Core Intent (communicative purpose), Art Style (visual/aesthetic class), Symbolic Meaning (cultural/archetypal signals). Returns a WeightedTagCloud: 12-20 typed tags per asset (tag, weight [0,1], category, rationale). VLM adapter: GPT-4o vision (primary) or heuristic fallback (filename + URL signals, no API key). Asset inputs: URL, base64/data-URI, filepath (Bun-native + Node fs fallback). analyseAssetBatch() processes multiple assets with configurable concurrency. dominantTags record the highest-weight tag per category. Deduplication by tag string keeping highest weight. minWeight filter and maxTags cap configurable. formatTagCloud() for logging; exportTagCloud() for storage.

tools.name: Semantic Tagging Layer — Taxonomy Evolver
tools.description: Compares new WeightedTagCloud[] against existing ExistingCategory[] taxonomy and evolves the directory structure. Pipeline: (1) build union vocabulary across all clouds + existing anchor tags; (2) vectorise each cloud as a tag-weight vector in that vocab space; (3) agglomerative single-linkage clustering with configurable cosine similarity threshold; (4) compute cluster cohesion (avg pairwise cosine); (5) match each cluster centroid to nearest existing category — if similarity < orphanThreshold, mark as orphaned; (6) name orphaned clusters via 20-entry seed keyword map (neon, retro, pixel-art, cyberpunk, botanical, occult, etc.) or top-2-tag fallback; (7) emit ManifestTaxonomyNode proposals ready for toolbox-manifest.json injection. TaxonomyEvolutionReport: totalClusters, orphanedClusters, coverageScore, singletonAssets. extractManifestNodes() pulls just the nodes. formatEvolutionReport() for human review.

tools.name: Format Extraction Engine — Structural Miner
tools.description: Takes a URL (fetched + HTML-stripped) or raw transcript and extracts a four-beat narrative timeline (HOOK → CONTEXT → TENSION → RESOLUTION) plus a topic-agnostic SkeletonJSON. Pipeline: (1) sentence segmentation; (2) sliding energy-window beat grouping; (3) phase assignment via signal keywords + position heuristics + energy; (4) per-beat metrics (lexical density, avg words/sentence, energy score, pacing label); (5) topic anonymisation — proper nouns, numbers, dates, locations replaced with typed {{SLOT}} placeholders. SkeletonJSON encodes structural fingerprint (e.g. 'H:punchy|C:slow|T:fast|R:medium'), beat templates, slot registry, and read-time estimate. Pass to format-transmuter.ts to regenerate for any target topic.

tools.name: Format Extraction Engine — Format Transmuter
tools.description: Takes a SkeletonJSON (from structural-miner) + a TargetTopic and generates a full ContentScript matching the source's high-retention pacing fingerprint. Slot resolver maps SUBJECT/CONCEPT/NUMBER/DATE/LOCATION slots to topic-specific terms. Sentence pattern library: per-phase (HOOK/CONTEXT/TENSION/RESOLUTION) × per-structural-cue (open-with-hypothetical, cold-open, contrast-tension, revelation-tension, escalation, lesson-close, payoff-close, etc.) pattern functions keyed to topic verbs/adjectives/numbers. Optional blendOriginalTemplates mode mixes slot-filled originals with generated patterns. appendCta appends a standalone call-to-action beat. transmuteMultiTopic() produces all topic variants from one skeleton in a single call. formatTeleprompterScript() emits a phase-headed teleprompter-ready script. 5 built-in presets: gematria, bio-audit, redesign-ai, yod-coin, yellow-pages. Fully extensible via TargetTopic interface.

tools.name: Anti-Fragile Orchestration — Agent Trinity Protocol
tools.description: Generic three-agent anti-fragile closed loop: WORKER produces an output, CRITIC evaluates it returning confidence [0,1] + typed CriticIssue[], FIXER corrects it. If CRITIC confidence < hallucinationThreshold (default 0.95), FIXER is invoked and the loop restarts — the system grows stronger under repeated correction. Blended stepSize update prevents oscillation. Returns CONVERGED when threshold is met or DEGRADED (best-seen output) after maxRounds. TrinityDegradedError thrown optionally. Fully generic over input type I and output type T — works for text, JSON, geometry, code. buildRuleCritic() helper composes validation rules into a critic agent. formatTrinityAudit() emits a per-round log string. aggregateIssues() groups all round issues by severity.

tools.name: Vision-to-3D Logic — Vision-to-Geometry Tool
tools.description: Converts 2D vision model output (bounding boxes + semantic labels) into a 3D SceneGraph of Primitive3D nodes ready for Redesign-AI. Semantic label → primitive mapping: building/skyscraper/house → Cube; tree/bush/sphere-like → Sphere; road/floor/water/grass → Plane; pole/tower/person → Cylinder; roof/cone-like → Cone. 30+ default COCO/ADE20K/cityscapes categories. Z-depth from bbox area (larger = closer) or depth-map median sampling. MaterialHint per category (baseColor, roughness, metallic, transparent, emissive). Redesign-AI tags auto-appended to every node. filterByPrimitive() and filterByRedesignTag() for downstream queries. exportSceneJSON() emits renderer-ready JSON. SemanticMappingConfig fully overridable.

tools.name: Scalar Data Correlation — Multi-Magnitude Processor
tools.description: Synchronizes two datasets at vastly different temporal or magnitude scales (e.g., nanosecond signals vs. monthly macro-trends). Pipeline: (1) sort + LTTB resample fine series to coarse cadence (shape-preserving); (2) z-score normalize both independently to collapse magnitude differences; (3) cross-correlation lag sweep [-maxLag, +maxLag] to find the optimal time offset between series; (4) align both series at optimal lag; (5) detect harmonic resonance points where fine-scale pattern predicts coarse-scale inflection via prominence threshold + windowed Pearson R + gradient filter. Returns optimalLag, peakR, and resonancePoints sorted by composite score (|R| × |gradient|). Each ResonancePoint is labelled PEAK or VALLEY based on coarse-series gradient polarity.

tools.name: Scalar Data Correlation — Equilibrium Solver
tools.description: Game-theory Nash Equilibrium solver for distributing Resource X across competing Node Y agents using Iterative Best-Response (IBR). Each node declares minAlloc, maxAlloc, weight, and a payoff function (logarithmic/sqrt/linear/concave). Each IBR round computes marginal-payoff-weighted best-response allocations, clips to node constraints, redistributes residuals, then blends with stepSize learning rate. Converges when max inter-round delta < tolerance. Returns per-node allocations with payoff, fraction, and constraint status; plus Jain fairness index, Gini inequality index, Shannon entropy, and stability classification. isNashEquilibrium() verifies no node can improve payoff by deviating by epsilon.

tools.name: Marketplace Gatekeeper — API Key Manager
tools.description: Cryptographically secure API key generation using CSPRNG (Web Crypto SubtleCrypto primary, Node crypto fallback). Key format: smf_{tier3}_{hex32}_{crc4} — 128-bit entropy, FNV-1a CRC4 suffix for structural validation without a DB hit. Three-tier validation pipeline: (1) CRC checksum, (2) registry lookup, (3) expiry/status/tool/origin checks. Full lifecycle: create, validate, validateTier, revoke, suspend, reinstate, rotate. In-memory store by default; swap to createSupabaseKeyStore() for production persistence. maskKey() for safe logging. Tier policies: BASIC (500 req/day), PRO (10 000 req/day, $29/mo), ENTERPRISE (unlimited, $299/mo), INTERNAL (sovereign).

tools.name: Marketplace Gatekeeper — Usage Tracker
tools.description: Two-counter request gating: per-minute sliding window (burst cap) checked first, then daily quota. Decisions: ALLOW (200), RATE_LIMITED (429 + Retry-After), QUOTA_EXCEEDED (429 + seconds-until-midnight). Increments per-key per-tool daily counters and tracks success vs rejected split. buildGateResponse() emits HTTP-ready status, headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, Retry-After), and JSON body. billingReport(startDate, endDate) aggregates revenue across all keys. Supabase adapter: upserts to api_usage table (key_id, date primary key). formatUsageLine() for structured log lines.

tools.name: Context Orchestration Layer — Context Relay
tools.protocol: Supabase Realtime WebSocket (phoenix channel format, vsn 1.0.0)
tools.description: Two-system context relay: TableWatcher subscribes to Supabase/Postgres table-change events (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) via Realtime WebSocket with exponential-backoff reconnection, heartbeat keepalive (25 s), per-subscription event filtering, and a 5 000-entry in-memory event log. MemoryScraper indexes .md files from the filesystem (Bun.Glob + Node fs fallback), extracts h1 titles, h2/h3 keywords, bold terms, YAML front-matter pillar tags, and scores every document against a WatcherEvent's tag set using weighted TF scoring (keyword 2×, body 1×, pillar-tag 1.5×) — returning the top-N most relevant MemoryDocument excerpts.

tools.name: Context Orchestration Layer — Just-In-Time Context Buffer
tools.description: Just-In-Time Context Buffer: assembles ContextPackets from three concurrent sources (DB state snapshot via Supabase REST, user activity logs, top-3 memory excerpts from MemoryScraper), stitches a unified keyword index, generates a terse natural-language summary, and times each gather phase. ContextInjector is a pure transform that attaches the packet to any AgentCall's metadata.context key without mutating the original. ContextOrchestrator wires buffer + injector into a single process() call. InProcessUserLogSink is an in-memory log store for dev. packetToPrompt() renders the full packet as an LLM-ready markdown prompt.

tools.name: Tool Manufacturing — Public API Packager
tools.description: Wraps internal Sovereign Mainframe engines (Gematria Scorer, Redesign Analyser, 3D Globe API) into versioned, metered Public API endpoints. API-Key management system: generate, validate, rate-limit (100–10,000 req/day by tier), rotate, revoke, and meter usage with per-tool breakdowns and USD-cent revenue estimates. Standalone Bun server on port 4002.

tools.name: Tool Manufacturing — Affiliate Link Manager
tools.description: Full affiliate link lifecycle: seed registry (8 offers across health, tech, software, books, crypto), Pillar 11 slot mapping (ad-slot / typing-segment / banner / product-card), HTTP HEAD health-check sweep with configurable TTL (1 h default), dead-link auto-swap with fallback resolution (named fallback → highest-priority active in same category), swap event log, leakage report, and offer scraper adapter for network APIs. Zero revenue leakage guarantee: every dead slot is replaced or flagged UNFILLED.

tools.name: Agentic Protocol — MCP Gateway & Bot-Sovereignty
tools.description: Exposes all active Sovereign Mainframe pillars as MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool and resource descriptors. Bot-Sovereignty enforces HMAC-SHA256 agent identity verification with four access tiers (PUBLIC / VERIFIED / SOVEREIGN / KEYMAKER) — gating Gematria, 4D spatial, and spectral data to verified agents only. Includes rate limiting (60 req/min default), audit log, and token revocation.

tools.name: Biological Audit — Parasite Tracker
tools.description: Uses High-Spectral Veil composite frame sequences to detect microscopic ectoparasite motion signatures. Extracts per-block NIR luminance oscillation time-series, estimates dominant Hz via zero-crossing rate, clusters spatially adjacent candidates, and scores against four taxon signature profiles (Demodex folliculorum/brevis, Sarcoptes, Pthirus). Cross-references findings with an 8-entry Cures vs. Suppressions treatment database with peer-reviewed references — including Ivermectin (oral + topical), Tea Tree Oil, Permethrin, Zinc adjunct, and CONTRAINDICATED entries (topical corticosteroids).

tools.name: Sovereign Ledger — Yod Token Contract (י)
tools.description: ERC-20 Yod Token (symbol: י) with a built-in 10% Tithe-Tax on every transfer, auto-routed to the GAB Research Vault address set at deployment. Includes typed ABI, pure-TS helpers (computeTithe, formatYod, parseYod, buildTransferCalldata, decodeTransferEvent, decodeTithePaidEvent), and a Move (Sui) scaffold comment block for future cross-chain porting.

tools.name: Sovereign Ledger — Ledger Bridge (NAS ↔ On-Chain)
tools.description: Connects the Yellow Pages DB to on-chain Yod token Transfer and TithePaid events via EVM JSON-RPC polling (zero external dependencies — raw fetch). When a Yod deposit to a watched Yellow Pages wallet is detected, awards Agent Credits and POSTs to the Synology NAS agent endpoint. Runs as a standalone Bun process or inside the api Docker container. Handles catch-up from configurable block depth on startup.

tools.name: Monetized Interface — Ad Sequencer Engine
tools.description: Priority-weighted 3D ad asset rotation engine (3.3 s intervals). Tracks impressions and clicks per-asset and per-advertiser in a Yellow Pages ledger. Provides pure-math helpers for WebGL rotation angle and billboard matrix computation. Zero framework imports — hooks into Three.js, Babylon.js, or raw WebGL via lifecycle callbacks.

tools.name: Monetized Interface — Typing Engine
tools.description: Real-time typing challenge engine backed by the GAB Historical-Truth segment library. Calculates WPM (5-char standard), raw WPM, accuracy, consistency (inverse of inter-key latency CV), and ETA per keystroke. Returns a character-level diff array for colour-coded UI rendering. Zero framework imports.

tools.name: High-Spectral Veil — Spectral Shift Engine
tools.description: Maps NIR/SWIR/UV/LWIR data streams into a Composite Visible Frame via configurable band-to-RGB mapping, per-channel gain, gamma correction, and LUT presets. Anomaly detection pipeline flags VELOCITY_EXCEED, THERMAL_GHOST, UV_FLARE, PHASE_INVERSION, and SPECTRAL_SPIKE events using z-scoring, Pearson correlation, and block-motion estimation.

tools.name: Omni-View — Sensor Fusion Engine
tools.description: GPS/GNSS normalization with inverse-accuracy-weighted ECEF fusion across Drone, Phone, RTK, and Satellite sources. Wi-Fi RSSI → 3D occupancy trilateration using Log-Distance Path Loss model and least-squares solver.

tools.name: Yellow Pages — Schema Generator
tools.description: Takes a JSON Intent (description + field list) and outputs a structured column array with inferred data types, roles, SQL types, Sheets format strings, and a ready-to-use CREATE TABLE statement.

tools.name: Yellow Pages — Formula Engine
tools.description: Generates Excel/Google Sheets compatible formula strings (SUM, VLOOKUP, GROWTH, FORECAST, CAGR, etc.) from column letters and FormulaContext. Platform-aware: handles Sheets vs Excel syntax differences.

tools.name: Pre-noetic Atmospheric Conditions — Physics Engine
tools.description: Models pre-Flood atmospheric conditions from a vapor canopy weight variable. Computes sea-level barometric pressure (P = ρgh), O2 partial pressure (Dalton's Law), and radiation shielding index. References Dillow (1981) and Vardiman (1994) canopy estimates.

schemas.name: Pre-noetic Atmospheric Conditions — UI State
schemas.description: JSON Schema tracking user slider positions (Pressure, O2, Radiation, Canopy) and derived physics outputs for the atmosphere information overlay.

Universal Governance covers two distinct sub-systems: the Agentic Protocol (MCP gateway, Bot-Sovereignty, pillar exposure) and the Biological Audit (spectral parasite detection, Cures vs. Suppressions database). Together they govern who and what may access the Mainframe, and what biological truth the Mainframe can observe.

nodes.name: MCP Pillar Registry
nodes.description: 13 MCP ToolDescriptors covering Pillars 1–13 + Pillar 14 bio-audit. 7 resource URIs (sovereign://...). Protocol version 2024-11-05.

nodes.name: Bot-Sovereignty
nodes.description: HMAC-SHA256 token system. Four access tiers: PUBLIC (no auth), VERIFIED (signed token), SOVEREIGN (Gematria/4D/spectral), KEYMAKER (full governance). Token format: base64url(identity).hmac. Audit log, rate limiter (60 req/min), revocation.

nodes.name: Capability Negotiation
nodes.description: McpGateway.negotiate() returns a tier-filtered McpCapabilityManifest. Agents only see tools they are authorised to call.

nodes.name: Spectral Parasite Detection
nodes.description: analyseForParasites() ingests Veil composite frames, extracts per-block NIR luminance oscillation series, estimates Hz via zero-crossing rate, clusters adjacent candidates, scores against 4 taxon signature profiles. Demodex Hz range: 0.05–0.5 Hz; Sarcoptes: 0.5–2.5 Hz.

domains.name: Neural Infrastructure
domains.description: Sixteenth pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Neural Infrastructure is the living connective tissue of the Mainframe — it observes every DB change, retrieves the most relevant memory, aggregates user state, and delivers a fully-formed ContextPacket to every outgoing agent call before it leaves the system. No agent call goes out cold.

nodes.name: Table Watchers
nodes.protocol: Supabase Realtime — phoenix channel format, vsn 1.0.0
nodes.description: TableWatcher opens a WebSocket to Supabase Realtime and joins phoenix channels for each registered table subscription. Supports per-subscription event filtering (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), Postgres row filter expressions (e.g. status=eq.active), multi-handler fan-out, heartbeat keepalive at 25 s, exponential-backoff reconnection (max 10 attempts, doubling from 1 s), and a 5 000-entry in-memory event log. WatcherEvent includes extracted tags from all string columns for downstream memory scoring.

nodes.name: Memory Scraper
nodes.description: MemoryScraper maintains an in-memory index of .md files. Ingestion: scanFilesystem() uses Bun.Glob (primary) or Node fs.readdir (fallback), caps at 512 KB per file. Extraction: h1 → title, h2/h3 headings + bold terms → keywords, YAML front-matter pillars: → pillarTags. Scoring: weighted TF over body tokens, keyword list, and pillar tags. Returns top-N MemoryMatch objects ranked by score, ties broken by indexedAt recency. Two ingestion modes: filesystem scan and programmatic ingestDocument() for Vercel/edge environments.

nodes.name: JIT Context Buffer
nodes.description: ContextBuffer.assemble() fires three concurrent async calls: dbProvider (Supabase REST snapshot of watched tables), logProvider (recent UserLogEntry[] for session), memProvider (top-3 MemoryMatches). Results are stitched into an immutable ContextPacket with a unified keyword index and a terse natural-language summary. Rolling history of last 100 packets retained in memory for debug and replay.

nodes.name: Context Injector
nodes.description: ContextInjector is a pure, non-mutating transform. inject(call, packet) returns a new InjectedAgentCall with metadata.context populated. injectBatch() processes N calls against the same packet in one pass. Configurable: metadataKey (default 'context'), omitDbData (for token-constrained models), includeFullMemory (excerpts vs. full content). extract() recovers the packet from any injected call.

nodes.name: Context Orchestrator
nodes.description: ContextOrchestrator.process(calls[], sessionId, opts) is the single integration point: assembles the packet and injects it into all provided agent calls in one await. assembleOnly() pre-warms the packet without injection. createOrchestratorFromEnv() wires everything from SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY with zero boilerplate. packetToPrompt() renders the full packet as LLM-ready markdown for direct system-prompt injection.

domains.name: Marketplace Infrastructure
domains.description: Fifteenth pillar of the Sovereign Mainframe. Marketplace Infrastructure governs the external commercialisation of internal tools — packaging them as metered Public APIs with API-key management, and ensuring all Pillar 11 affiliate slots remain revenue-generating through automatic dead-link detection and replacement.

nodes.name: Public API Packaging
nodes.description: PublicApiGateway exposes internal tools as versioned REST endpoints. API key format: smf_{tier}_{32-hex}. Key lifecycle: create, validate, rotate, revoke. Metering: per-tool daily counters, overage billing in USD cents ($0.20–0.50 / 1 000 overage calls by tier). Standalone Bun server port 4002.

nodes.name: API Key Management
nodes.description: ApiKeyManager: in-memory store (port to Supabase/Convex for persistence). issueToken/rotate/revoke lifecycle. Per-key allowedTools, allowedOrigins, rateLimitRpdOverride. exportUsageReport() returns 30-day rollup with revenue estimates.

nodes.name: Affiliate Link Management
nodes.description: AffiliateLinkManager: seed registry with 8 built-in offers (health, tech, software, books, crypto). Maps offers to Pillar 11 ad-slots + typing-segments. HTTP HEAD health sweep every 1 h (configurable TTL). Dead-link auto-swap: named fallback → highest-priority active in same category → UNFILLED flag. SwapEvent log for audit trail. scrapeAffiliateOffers() adapter for live network feeds. estimateAnnualRevenueCents() forecasting helper.

nodes.name: Marketplace Gatekeeper
gatePipeline: 1. CRC4 checksum on raw key (no DB hit)
nodes.description: Two-tool gatekeeper pair. KeyManager generates 128-bit CSPRNG keys (smf_{tier3}_{hex32}_{crc4}), validates via 5-step pipeline, and manages full lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke/suspend/reinstate). UsageTracker gates every request through per-minute sliding window then daily quota, returning structured ALLOW/RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED decisions with HTTP 200/429 + Retry-After. buildGateResponse() emits headers and body. billingReport() aggregates revenue. Both tools ship in-memory stores (dev) and Supabase REST adapters (production).

nodes.name: Zero Revenue Leakage Protocol
nodes.description: Guarantee: no Pillar 11 ad slot remains dead longer than one health-check TTL cycle. Swap resolution order: 1) named fallbackOfferId on the dead offer, 2) highest-priority ACTIVE offer in same category, 3) UNFILLED — triggers onUnfilled() callback and appears in getRevenueLeakageReport(). All swaps emit a typed SwapEvent with SwapReason, timestampMs, and descriptive note.
